Class MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder
Enclosing class:
MetroOptimizer
public static final class MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for defining a user site. A site represents a workforce location, customer market, or operational facility whose proximity to candidate metros is factored into the optimization scoring.

Location can be specified either by nearestMetro(MetroCode) or by coordinates(double, double). If both are provided, the nearest metro takes precedence for latency lookups while coordinates are used as a fallback for distance-based estimates.

  • Method Details

    • nearestMetro

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder nearestMetro(MetroCode metro)
      Sets the nearest Equinix metro to this site. Used for direct latency lookups in the Fabric metro interconnection data. This is the preferred way to specify site location when the nearest metro is known.
      Parameters:
      metro - the Equinix metro code nearest to this site
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • coordinates(double, double)

    • nearestMetro

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder nearestMetro(String metroCode)
      Sets the nearest metro by its raw code string — use this for a metro not listed by the MetroCode enum.
      Parameters:
      metroCode - the metro code nearest to this site (e.g. "NY")
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • nearestMetro

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder nearestMetro(MetroId metroId)
      Sets the nearest metro by its MetroId.
      Parameters:
      metroId - the id of the metro nearest to this site
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining

    • coordinates

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder coordinates(double latitude, double longitude)
      Sets the geographic coordinates of this site. Used for great-circle distance calculations when no direct metro latency data is available, or when nearestMetro(MetroCode) is not set.
      Parameters:
      latitude - the latitude in decimal degrees (e.g., 40.7128 for New York)
      longitude - the longitude in decimal degrees (e.g., -74.0060 for New York)
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • nearestMetro(MetroCode)

    • role

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder role(SiteRole role)
      Sets the business role of this site. The role determines an importance multiplier that influences how heavily the optimizer weighs proximity to this site. Defaults to SiteRole.BRANCH_OFFICE.
      Parameters:
      role - the business role of this site
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • SiteRole

    • headcount

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder headcount(int headcount)
      Sets the number of employees or users at this site. When no explicit weight(double) is set, headcount is normalized across all sites to derive relative importance in scoring.
      Parameters:
      headcount - the number of employees or users at this site
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • weight(double)

    • weight

      public MetroOptimizer.SiteBuilder weight(double weight)
      Sets an explicit importance weight for this site, overriding the headcount-based normalization. Values are relative to other sites; for example, a weight of 2.0 makes this site twice as important as a site with weight 1.0.
      Parameters:
      weight - the explicit importance weight (must be positive to take effect)
      Returns:
      this builder for method chaining
      See Also:
      • headcount(int)
